hook_text: Petrol goes up - watch what happens to your taxi fare. That's economics.
clip_script: I'm Bra Sipho, the Taxi Rank Economist. Petrol goes up - watch what happens to your taxi fare. That's economics, right there on the street. Let’s talk about a word they love in the textbooks: elasticity. Before you start sweating over graphs, think about your morning commute. The marshal says the fare just went up from R15 to R20. What happens? Some people will grumble but still get in, because they have to be at work. But others? They turn around, go to the bus stop, or share a lift. That reaction is elasticity. It's just a fancy word for 'how much do people jump when the price bites them?' If people run away fast, we say the demand is elastic. If they just stand there and take it, it's inelastic.
